metadata.title: Realt AI — Make better housing decisions
metadata.description: Realt AI is an intelligent decision assistant that helps you understand your priorities, weigh trade-offs, and confidently choose the right home.

footer.tagline: Realt AI helps you understand your priorities before you look at properties.

home.heading: People don't buy apartments. People buy a future life.
home.subheading: Realt AI helps you understand what actually matters to you, weighs the trade-offs honestly, and explains every recommendation — so you can choose a home with confidence, not guesswork.

howItWorks.heading: The Realt Thinking Framework
howItWorks.subheading: The same reasoning process behind every recommendation Realt AI makes.

understand.title: Understand your goals
understand.description: Tell Realt AI what matters to you in plain language — budget, commute, space, safety, schools, lifestyle.

tradeoffs.title: See the trade-offs
tradeoffs.description: Realt AI flags conflicts between your priorities honestly, instead of pretending every box can be checked.

match.title: Get a transparent match
match.description: Every property comes with an explainable score — you always see exactly why it fits, or why it doesn't.

decide.title: Decide with confidence
decide.description: Compromises and risks are called out up front, so you choose a home knowingly, not by accident.

finalCta.heading: Ready to think through your next home?
finalCta.subheading: It takes a few minutes to describe what matters to you. No account required.

onboarding.metaTitle: Tell us what you're looking for
onboarding.metaDescription: Describe your priorities so Realt AI can understand what matters to you.

describe.heading: Tell us what you're looking for
describe.description: Describe your ideal home in your own words. Include what matters most — budget, commute, space, safety, schools, or lifestyle.
describe.label: Your priorities
describe.placeholder: We're a family of four looking for a 3-4 bedroom home under $600,000, ideally a 30 minute drive or less to downtown, in a quiet, family-friendly neighborhood with good schools. A backyard would be great, and we'd rule out anything without off-street parking.
describe.hint: Realt AI only uses what you write here — it won't invent details you didn't mention.

review.heading: Review your priorities
review.description: Here's what Realt AI understood. Adjust anything before we look for matches.
review.offlineDescription: No AI model is configured, so priorities were extracted with a simpler, rule-based reader. Review the fields below carefully.

dealBreakers.label: Deal-breakers
dealBreakers.description: Anything that would rule a property out.

lifestyle.label: Lifestyle
lifestyle.description: How you want the neighborhood to feel.

recommendations.metaDescription: Properties matched and explained against your stated priorities.
